text: hm. tho that made it come back in an annoying way. i cant see what is on a floor because of the floor above it where it use to only show the floor and below it
resolution: After buildings returned, all floors showed at once so an upper floor occluded the floor being edited. Cause: commit 79da84357 forced showAllFloors=true as a band-aid for the mis-diagnosed vanishing-buildings bug. With the real cause fixed, restored the cut-away default (showAllFloors=false): pane shows the active floor and below; toggle still reveals the whole city. NOTE: showAllFloors is a persisted route twig, so an existing saved true needs one toggle click to clear before the default applies.
